checked_profile.summary: Personal loans with fee deductions and discount conditions to compare.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Repayment and APR
facts.text: Published repayment terms are 24–84 months, with APRs of 7.74%–35.99%. Approval and available offers depend on the applicant.

facts.label: Origination fee
facts.text: The published 1.85%–9.99% origination fee is deducted from loan proceeds, reducing the amount received.

facts.label: Lowest-rate conditions
facts.text: The lowest advertised rates require AutoPay and paying some existing debt directly. Certain discounts may require collateral; offers vary by state and applicant.

facts.label: Joint applications and payoff
facts.text: Joint applications are accepted, and both applicants are responsible for repayment. The page states there is no early-payoff fee.
